notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001633917-26-000024, filed February 3, 2026) and match SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 7, 2026, accession 0001193125-26-145721), shares as of March 25, 2026 (899,673,971 outstanding). SCHULMAN: he was CEO until September 2023 (the 2026 proxy's pay-versus-performance notes say 'Mr. Schulman served as the Principal Executive Officer ("PEO") in 2023 from January 1 through September 26'). He is not a director or named executive officer in the 2026 proxy and is not in its security ownership tables, so his status is no-reported-stake. The company's CEO has changed again: the proxy says the Board 'appointed Enrique Lores as PayPal's President and CEO effective March 1' 2026, succeeding Alex Chriss. HOLDERS: the proxy bases Vanguard's 10.05% on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 30, 2026, and adds that a later 13G/A (Amendment No. 10, filed March 27, 2026) reports The Vanguard Group 'does not beneficially own any shares' after an internal reorganization that disaggregated its beneficial ownership; the table's figure is kept as the proxy lists it. BlackRock's 8.06% still rests on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 26, 2024, so it is stale. The proxy gives filing dates, not holding dates, so asOf is null. DIVIDENDS: PayPal began a quarterly dividend in October 2025; the first, $0.14 per share (about $130 million), was paid December 10, 2025. BUYBACKS exclude $383 million of tax withholdings on net share settlement of equity awards. STOCK COMP is the cash-flow add-back; the equity statement shows $1,135 million of stock-based compensation.

ecosystem.notes: The FY2025 10-K states TPV rounded, as $1.79 trillion, and gives no exact figure. TPV includes payments enabled by PayPal through a partner payment solution and excludes gateway-exclusive transactions.
ecosystem.ratioNote: PayPal revenue includes other value added services (credit interest and fees, partnerships, interest on assets) that are not earned on payment volume, so revenue ÷ TPV is not a like-for-like share.

taxes.notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds as presented (the FY2025 10-K still prints the supplemental cash-flow line). R&D: PayPal's income statement shows 'Technology and development', but Item 1 states total research and development expense of $1.5 billion (stated to one decimal); no XBRL fact for this sentence.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001633917-26-000024). Payments company: normal operating cash flow, formula with the sector flag. Customer balances (funds payable) are in financing and funds receivable in investing, so they do not distort operating cash flow. Held-for-sale loan originations net of repayments and sales (1,316) lowered operating cash flow in 2025, so paidOut is overstated by about that amount (flagged, not adjusted).

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 21, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K ('predominantly full-time'). Payroll: the 10-K gives no total staff cost (only year-over-year changes in 'employee-related costs' by expense line), so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used. The median employee is paid in euros and was converted at the December 31, 2025 exchange rate; the population was full-time employees worldwide (including interns) as of December 1, 2025.
